verdict.rationale: GitHub docs confirm pre-request scripting ("Snippets of code... executed before the request is sent") plus request variables for chaining data between requests, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents post-response scripts/tests for massaging response data, only CLI test running and JUnit reports. missing for 10: explicit post-response scripting/test-script documentation, examples of chaining via scripts, independent hands-on confirmation of script execution.
